recommendations.evidence: policy.normalize filters params against PARAMETERS; registry.effective_parameters independently filters against COMMON_PARAMETERS|MODEL_PARAMETERS.
recommendations.action: Keep one catalog ID in the intended params field and both whitelists. Validate an explicitly supplied ID/engine before filtering; reject unknown/incompatible profiles and conflicting raw objective/alpha/loss aliases instead of silently producing a baseline. Validate direct worker/adapter dispatch too because normalize has no task kind and can be bypassed. Preserve the absent-profile constructor/recipe/signature behavior.

recommendations.evidence: lightgbm.py5-10 supplies the custom primary eval callback only for early_metric=primary;29-30 suppresses default library metric with metric='None'.
recommendations.action: For enabled L2/L1/fixedHuber0.9 profiles require primary stopping, including direct jobs, and retain both the suppressed default metric and original official callback. Otherwise switching objective can silently switch first_metric_only stopping to L1/Huber loss. Keep patience/min_iterations/split rule and seeds fixed; best iteration may legitimately differ.

recommendations.evidence: worker204-206 trains fit_y in log1p scale when requested; callbacks16-23 applies expm1 before original-scale regression metric; worker342-359 also inverts predictions for evaluation.
recommendations.action: Hold log_target and all weighting/preprocessing/smearing configurations fixed across the first loss comparison. Objectives act on the supplied fitting target scale while admission remains original-scale RMSE. Do not substitute log-RMSE/default loss, add clipping, tune alpha or repair a failed profile. Preserve nonfinite/overflow failures as null.

recommendations.evidence: worker203/294/302/313/331 constructs several models for inner stopping and refit; constructor get_params can describe requested/default rather than resolved booster objective.
recommendations.action: Apply the profile in shared LightGBM creation so every inner/final instantiation retains it. After successful fits record a small whitelist from model.booster_.params: objective, relevant fixed alpha and metric, plus requested ID/expected mapping, library version, target scale and fit stage. Explicitly compare actual versus requested supported objective; pre-fit or mocked telemetry must not be labelled actual training.

recommendations.evidence: policy.signature uses effective_parameters; HPO168 copies the recipe then normalizes it, so an omitted whitelist key can collapse all loss variants.
recommendations.action: Distinct executed losses must have distinct executable signatures and saved recipe/cache bindings, including fixed profile identity. Preserve profile through HPO copies and final iteration reuse. Reuse cached predictions or HPO observations only with matching profile/source/params/input/split/ordered rows/target transform, not just the same learning-rate/depth. Decide explicitly whether an explicit L2 and absent default are semantically deduplicated; never hide a dropped requested profile as a completed experiment.

recommendations.evidence: Existing LightGBM classification already resolves softmax/ova through multiclass_strategy; feature-view validation requires its supported softmax path.
recommendations.action: V1 exposes only the three regression profiles and rejects any such profile on classification. Leave absent-profile multiclass_strategy behavior unchanged. Do not advertise softmax/ova profile IDs or add a second conflicting classification objective knob until a separately reconciled interface exists.

recommendations.evidence: Raw T7 discover profile uses full-train target_summary/class_counts, and generic planner feedback contains outer search values. Neither provenance becomes inner-only through a prompt label.
recommendations.action: Use a whitelist of fact IDs from actual inner heldout/OOF predictions within outer fitting rows, bound to control/source/input/split/ordered fitting and diagnostic rows. Exclude outer primary/confirmation and HPO-confirmation outcomes and full-train target summaries from this loss-selection context. Inner HPO validation may guide inner selection but is not an independent confirmation. Unknown/missing provenance or budget yields skip; large residuals alone do not establish outliers.

skill_review.matches_user_attachment: Fixed target metric; one supported catalog profile with evidence or skip; same features/weights/transform/stopping in first comparison; original target scale; inner-only facts; explicit reject/no silent drop; actual objective/signature/cache checks; preserve failures/cost; distinguish catalog benefit from Qwen selection via matched A/B/C budgets.
skill_review.boundary: Generic Codex instructions only. The file does not make Qwen consume a skill, expose an implemented catalog, create eligible diagnostics or prove ML gain. Tool schema must resolve control_id/evidence_refs against its frozen inner-only facts. Regression-only initial implementation is honest because unavailable class profiles are not exposed.
